# Hi-tech 190 (from Wake Up and Remember)

Ficha do template `hitech-ref` (versão 1). Estilo: Hi-tech.

Hi-tech built from Diogo's references (Wake Up, Remember): kick and bass almost all the time, intro 8, breaks of 8 and 16, one bar without low end every 32; a semitone walking KBBB bass in A; a dry W-Core lead (no reverb, no delay) whose 7- and 5-step cycles over the 4/4 make an irregular figure that repeats every 2 bars and opens over each 16; layers that come and go every 16. 296 bars, about 6:14. A hypothesis until Diogo hears it.
